boxes.title: Civil services: added detail
items: Cornwallis: ban on **gifts**; **seniority** promotions; separated revenue from justice
**Haileybury** course: law, political economy, Indian languages
**Indian Civil Services Act 1861**: Indians mainly to **uncovenanted** posts (**7+** years' residence, local language exam)
Statutory Civil Service: ==**1/6** of covenanted posts== to Indians of "high families"; later abolished
1922 exam in India: **Allahabad**, later **Delhi** (UPPSC 2021: both statements correct)

boxes.title: Courts: added detail
head: Who / Act
Point
rows: Separated commercial, judicial, revenue branches; Sadar adalats under **G-G in Council**

boxes.title: High Courts Act 1861: more
items: High Courts ==replaced the Supreme Courts and Sadar Adalats==

boxes.title: Local self-government: more
head: Item
Point
rows: Provinces got fixed grants for police, jails, education, medical + local taxes; BPSC 2023: all four true
Unofficial members in panchayats, municipal councils, **district boards**
Village panchayats set up in several provinces
Bodies starved of funds, controlled by officials

boxes.title: Wider angles
items: Police Act 1861: meant to ==suppress dissent==; built for control, not service
Ilbert Bill: covered **district magistrates and sessions judges**; showed Indians the value of organised agitation
1850s **Andhra petitions**: trained judges, police separate from revenue officials
2026: AP Judicial Academy **Rs 130.38 crore**; pending cases over **5 crore**; Karnataka KPSC chair suspended, **Art. 317(1)**
